Startups & AI · the private layer

The private giants: 1,442 unicorns are marked at $7.3 trillion — and two AI labs make up a quarter of it

Who the world's $1B+ venture-backed private companies are, where they sit, who funded them, and how the AI race has bent the whole board towards a handful of San Francisco labs. Paper valuations, not prices — read the caveat boxes before quoting.

Where the unicorns live

The US holds more than half of all unicorns and about two-thirds of their value. Industry and year filters apply; the country filter highlights a bar rather than hiding the rest.

The unicorn wave

The year a company first crossed a $1B valuation. 2021's zero-interest-rate frenzy minted three in ten of today's unicorns; the AI boom is now producing a second wave.

2021 minted 433 unicorns — more than 2017-2020 combined; 2026 is the biggest year since

The power law

Most unicorns barely clear the bar. Venture capital is a hits business: a few outliers carry the whole asset class.

The AI race: where the money concentrated

The atlas AI registry tracks 173 model builders across 15 modalities — labs, chips, robotics, video, biology. Matched to the unicorn board, AI companies are 6% of unicorns but about 31% of the value.

AI-native companies now take a large share of new unicorn value

Current valuation ($B) of board companies by year joined · AI-native vs everything else · filters apply

AI-native = name matches the atlas AI registry, or contains "AI"/".ai". A conservative tag: AI-heavy firms with other names (Databricks, Scale, VAST Data) are partly included only via the registry.
